title: pm: a seat's claimed model tier has a mechanical source and a check — sister-repo `--tier` from the globs, ceiling claims cite their mandate, never-up rule, `Local-runs:` record line and a reviewer brief
body:
Fixes #20250
Clause-②: no

A sister-repo seat's claim `model:` line had no mechanical source (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` refused a sister checkout), nothing read the line, no rule said a quota wall moves DOWN only, and the review record had no line showing whether the reviewer ran anything locally. Four gaps, four commits, one card.

## What changed

**G1 — `--tier --repo SISTER PATH…` answers a governed sister repo from the path globs alone** (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`). The tier question is a pure predicate over the paths and `MANDATORY_TIER_GLOBS` / `SUSPECT_TIER_GLOBS`; the refusal it inherited belonged to the gate-family half, which reads the tree. `sisterRepoTierRun` answers a slug the governed register (`GOVERNED_REPOS` in `check-governed-merges.mjs`) knows, prints on stderr that the sister tree was NOT read and that its gate families still derive only from a checkout OF it, and prints the tier verdict plus a `Changed lines — NOT MEASURED` line on stdout, paste-clean. A sister slug with no paths refuses (exit 2): no diff of another repo is readable here. Every other mode keeps the wrong-repo refusal, which now points at the tier route. This repo's own slug, an unknown slug and a checkout path are untouched (`null` from the sister run, the old refusal answers them).

Proof the tier half needs no tree: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier skills/objectui/SKILL.md --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` answers `MANDATORY … ⇢ 'skills/**'` at exit 0 from this checkout, where that path does not exist; `deriveTier` calls `hintCovers` over the two glob tables and nothing else, and the `--tier` branch of the CLI never reaches `derive()`.

**G2 — a claim naming the ceiling tier cites its mandate or a reason** (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`). `readContainerModelLine` / `containerModelRefusal` live beside the ladder constants (the owner of the tier vocabulary) and read the FIRST token after `model:` on a `Container & model:` line, decoration stripped, exactly as `Served-tier:` is read. A ceiling spelling — the constant's NAME `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, its value, or the ladder's family word while the ceiling is a tier of its own — owes, on the SAME line, the word `MANDATORY` (which `--tier` prints only for a mandated surface) or `reason:` naming the per-card ruling. `post-stamped.mjs` imports it as the fourth claim reader beside `Seat:` / `Thread-read:` / `Clause-②:` (same mechanism as the `Thread-read:` refusal; `close-cards.mjs` inherits it through its pre-flight import). The default and floor tiers cite nothing; a claim with no line, or a `model:` slot reading no token, is not refused — older claims never carried the line, and the reader judges a ceiling, not an omission. The refusal names the ceiling by the constant's NAME and quotes no model identifier. `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER_NAME` is now declared beside the constant it names and re-exported from `record-recognisers.mjs`.

Measured on the real claim on this card (`model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` … `MANDATORY — …`): reads as ceiling, mandate cited, no refusal. The incident spelling `model: fable (the ceiling)` (the ladder word, nothing behind it): refused.

**G3 — a quota wall moves DOWN only, never up, and a temporary deviation expires** (`references/execution-duties.md`, one clause, zero net lines). The two downgrade-exit lines fold into one (the parenthetical 「余量吃紧可预先降档」 is derivable from 「预降」 and paid the line); the freed line states the other half the policy never said: 「额度墙只向下(降档或降并发)⛔ 永不向上;临时偏离记座位贴带结束条件,逐次巡检重读。」 183 / 183 lines, both lines 118 bytes under the 120-byte cap.

**G4 — the record's `Local-runs:` line and a reviewer brief with the read-only shape built in** (`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`, `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, `references/contract-review.md`; its own commit). `--template` now prints `Local-runs: none`; `readLocalRuns` / `localRunsStand` grade the line ONLY when present (`none`, or `probe — REASON` naming the one local run and why); an absent line is `missing` and STANDS — the three landed PASS records on PR 20254 / 20256 / 20257 carry no line and are not re-judged (pinned: the legacy fixture record reads `missing` and stands). `post-stamped.mjs` refuses a `## Contract review` comment whose `Local-runs:` line is present and unreadable, before the write (a probe with no reason names no deviation). `--brief-template` prints the brief a seat hands its contract reviewer: the ⛔ READ-ONLY lines (no worktree, no checkout, no build, no test run, no gate re-run, no ablation; the head's check-runs ARE the gate verdicts), the input set (card, PR, check-runs — not the dispatch order, not the dispatching seat's conclusions), the PR-named scratch directory, the record's own template named rather than restated, no angle brackets, no model identifier. `contract-review.md` gains the two rule lines (36 → 40 / 60; each rule wrapped once under the 120-byte cap).

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`: the diff touches `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only — the fast lane, nothing in any package's `files[]`; consistent with `Clause-②: no`.

## Deviations (from the dispatch order's mechanism assumptions)

1. Assumption 8 (every self-test is battery-name + floor) is FALSE for `dispatch-gates.mjs`: its self-test pins one count floor (`detailedCases` at least 6) and no battery roster (`docs/audits/2026-09-self-test-shape-census.md` records it as `NONE | HELD`). New cases were added as plain `t()` calls; there was no floor to raise.
2. The issue's premise that a sister repo has none of the protocol-semantics surfaces is false for objectui: its `skills/objectui/**` matches the published-catalog glob `skills/**` (the register's own note calls objectui "the UI repo (live skills/** tree)"), so a sister `--tier` answers MANDATORY for it — the glob policy applied as written, said on stderr. The core premise (`--tier` refused a sister checkout; every sister claim was hand-written) holds and is what G1 closes.
3. A live-tree census pin in the dispatch-gates self-test names the `inherited-population` marker by line; the one header usage line moved it 713 → 714, repaired in its own commit.
4. `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER_NAME` moved to `dispatch-gates.mjs` (beside the constant) and is re-exported from `record-recognisers.mjs`, so the claim reader and the record reader compare against one spelling.
5. `contract-review.md` grew by 4 lines, not 2: both new rules exceeded the 120-byte cap as single lines and were wrapped once.
6. G4's enforcement door is post-stamped's write-time refusal (in the claimed file surface). The merge-queue guard (`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, outside the surface) does not read `Local-runs:`; whether it should is an open question in the report.
7. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` untouched: the claim template's `model:` slot already says to quote the `--tier` output, which now exists for sister repos and carries the MANDATORY word G2 reads.

## Acceptance notes

- Neighbour card 19603 (the reviewer-tier fuse) is not addressed here.
- The wrong-repo refusal's new hint line prints only for a governed sister slug; an unknown slug's refusal is byte-identical to before.
- `sisterRepoTierRun` takes the register by injection (`repos`, `selfId`) so the self-test can drive a register naming no sister.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:四件事。① `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo 姊妹仓 路径…` 现在能为姊妹仓(objectui 等治理仓)只按路径 glob 给出档位判定,不再拒答;② 认领评论的 `Container & model:` 行若把 `model:` 写成上限档,同一行必须带 `--tier` 打印的 `MANDATORY` 或 `reason:`,否则 `post-stamped` 写前拒收;③ `execution-duties.md` 加一句:额度墙只向下、永不向上,临时偏离要记座位贴并带结束条件;④ 复核记录模板加 `Local-runs:` 行(`none` 或 `probe — 原因`),旧记录缺行不改判,并新增 `--brief-template` 打印带只读条款的复核简报。

**为什么改**:objectui 席位在额度墙后整班把上限档手写进每条认领,没有任何机械读数或检查能发现,直到周额度 94%;同一班复核简报手写丢了只读条款,每次复核 25–43 万 token。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:新增拒收只针对「上限档且无引用」的认领和「有 `Local-runs:` 行但读不出」的记录;默认档/下限档认领、无该行的旧认领与旧记录一律不受影响。dispatch-gates 自测多 32 例、post-stamped 多 21 例、record-recognisers 多 26 例。回滚 = revert 四个 commit,无发布面、无 changeset。

**席位意见**:(留空)

**你要做的**:一个动作——席位达档复核 PASS 后由席位经中继落地(Tier S),无需你操作;若你想改 G3 那句的措辞,直接在评论里给原话。
